**Systemic renderer problems (fix these and nearly all DEFECTs clear):**
1. **Chip width underestimated** — generator sizes the chip from a naive `0.16 * len(label)` formula; at rendered font metrics the text clips (Check-In, Exercise, Lecture, Session Goals chips). Fix: measure or add generous padding (harness chips have ~2x the horizontal padding).
2. **Timing pill oversized and colliding** — NEW exercise slides render a fixed 3.2in-wide blue pill that long titles run beneath (slides 12, 29, 37, 42) or that forces 2-line titles into the steps (43). Harness pills are compact, right-aligned, and titles are width-constrained to avoid them.
3. **Fixed-position boxes create dead space** — done-when box anchored near the bottom regardless of content height (big empty band on every NEW exercise slide), goal boxes and compare rows fixed-height and half-empty.
4. **Missing harness text styling on NEW slides** — compare right column not bold; session-goal titles lack the blue accent run; lecture bullets use literal "•" instead of the harness's blue dot/hanging-indent list style.
5. **Intro background shows white rounded corners** — full-bleed shape rendered as rounded rectangle instead of square.

Copied-slide fidelity is 100%; nothing copied needs rework. Two tiny source-side artifacts (slides 25, 26 nits) exist in the DLP originals and are out of scope here.
